coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: Each form page is a 1055 x 1365 px picture (140 ppi) drawn at x 40.1-584.3, y 53.5-757.5 pt; lines and squares located on the picture's pixels (plines.py, squares.py) and converted through the drawing matrix; every picture page looked at; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: A form of subscription agreement filed as page pictures: the company accepts on its own page (officer printed); the investor signs page 37 with registration, contact and amount details and ticks Schedule A. No joint investor block.
